svg.title: Tiled placement on a small tree
svg.desc: A 24-leaf tree cut into 5 tiles of at most 12 edges. A bottom-up pass keeps the distal vector of each tile root, a top-down pass its proximal vector; placement then holds one tile in memory at a time.

text.tspan: build the tiles in turn, keep the distal vector D of each tile root
keep the proximal vector P of each tile root
one tile in memory at a time; its boundary vectors are all it needs
D, P: the boundary vectors kept for each tile root
